0022600129.text: The Pistons (3-0, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) make the road trip to New York, where they are 2-0 away from home in their fourth game of the season, while the 0-3 Knicks sit 12th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Atlantic. Detroit is without Jalen Duren, who is out with a hamstring strain, and Ausar Thompson and Isaiah Joe are day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a hip bruise, respectively, and both are game-time decisions. New York is missing Jose Alvarado, who is out with an ankle sprain. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pistons won all three games against the Knicks in 2025-26, including a 126-111 win in New York on February 19, 2026.
